summary: Seabridge Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held June 24, 2026. The meeting covered routine items: election of ten director nominees (all received >97% support), reappointment of KPMG LLP as auditor (96.93% for), authorization to fix auditor remuneration (98.28% for), and an advisory vote on executive compensation (96.17% for). This is a standard annual meeting outcome report with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine disclosure of voting results with no deal terms or strategic changes.
